fact: The team moves from the Station Road office to Riverside House, 14 Canal Street. The first working day at Riverside House is Monday 7 December 2026.
Wednesday 2 December 2026 is the last working day at Station Road. The office closes at 16:00 that day.
On Thursday 3 and Friday 4 December everyone works from home while the movers pack and move the furniture.
Each person gets two moving crates. Pack your crates by 16:00 on Wednesday 2 December and label them with your name and your team's zone.
The empty crates are delivered to Station Road on Monday 30 November.
IT packs and moves all monitors, docking stations and keyboards. Do not pack them yourself.
Take your laptop and charger home with you on Wednesday 2 December.
Riverside House uses shared desks that you book in the DeskBook app. Booking opens on Monday 30 November.
Each team has a home zone on floor 2, marked A to D. Book a desk in your team's zone when you can.
New access badges are handed out at the Riverside House reception from 08:00 on Monday 7 December. Bring photo ID.
Riverside House has 20 parking spaces, booked in the DeskBook app. 4 accessible spaces next to the entrance are kept for people who need them.
There is covered storage for 40 bikes behind the building, and showers on the ground floor.
Riverside House is a 5-minute walk from Central bus station. Bus 12 stops outside the building.
The staff Wi-Fi network at Riverside House is 'Riverside-Staff'. Laptops connect to it automatically after the IT update on Tuesday 1 December.
There is a printer on every floor. Use your access badge at the printer to release your print.
Every floor has a kitchen. The canteen on the ground floor is open from 11:30 to 14:00.
Lockers are on floor 2 and open with your access badge.
Questions about the move go to the move team at move-team@example.com.
IT questions go to it-help@example.com. Building questions go to facilities@example.com.
Riverside House has a lift to every floor and a hearing loop at reception.
Anyone who may need help to leave the building in an emergency should ask facilities for a personal evacuation plan before Monday 7 December.
The first fire drill at Riverside House is on Wednesday 9 December 2026 at 10:30. It takes about 15 minutes.
The assembly point is the car park on the Canal Street side, marked 'Assembly point B'.
Each floor has two fire wardens in yellow vests. Follow their instructions during the drill.
During a fire drill, leave by the nearest stairs, not the lift, and do not stop to collect your belongings.
Evacuation chairs are kept at every stairwell. Trained fire wardens help anyone with a personal evacuation plan.
The hybrid-work rule does not change with the move: you can work from home up to 2 days a week.
